title: Academy
no_access: You do not have active access to this academy.
teaching_overview_description: See who needs support and what to teach next.
student_analytics_description: Every student in your assigned classes, with the measurements behind each figure.
control_tower_description: One picture of the academy: what needs a decision, and whether the classes are alive.

settings.title: Academy settings
settings.description: What this academy has switched on.
settings.requires: Needs {{title}}. Turning this on turns that on too.

TEACHER_LIVE_MONITORING.title: Live monitoring
TEACHER_LIVE_MONITORING.body: Teachers can watch their students work in real time — the editor, the terminal, as it is typed.

STUDENT_CLASS_STANDING.title: Class standing
STUDENT_CLASS_STANDING.body: Students see where they sit in their class. This is the one place a student is told anything about another student.

STUDENT_POINTS.title: Points
STUDENT_POINTS.body: Students earn points for solved problems. With this off no point is ever recorded.

STUDENT_CLASS_LEADERBOARD.title: Class leaderboard
STUDENT_CLASS_LEADERBOARD.body: A named ranking of the class, by points. Replaces class standing where both are on.
